statement:
The ordered dose of 480 mg of acetaminophen is not safe or correct for this 6.0 kg infant, as the standard pediatric dosage is 10–15 mg/kg (60–90 mg per dose), making 480 mg (80 mg/kg) a severe, potentially toxic overdose.

I cannot administer this dose. Please hold the medication and contact the prescriber, Dr. Ibarra, to clarify and correct the order to a safe dose (60–90 mg).
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer states "480 mg (80 mg/kg) a severe, potentially toxic overdose" and gives the correct dose of 60–90 mg.
